chapters.caption: Contour plate: chamfer, round notch and a 1 mm wide tab
Layer at z 1 mm: only the first border (red) around the hatch
Chamfer: one border, then the hatch starts
The 1 mm tab: one border, hatch in the middle
Following borders: switch from off to on
Each ring is 0.08 mm further inside than the one before
After: three more rings inside the first border
They follow the chamfer at 0.14, 0.22 and 0.30 mm
Tab: the hatch now starts 0.35 mm inside instead of 0.11 mm
